newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lyttelton Port expects similar conditions.
newsitem.headline: Lyttelton Port expects similar conditions.

text.p: Lyttelton Port said on Wednesday it expected similar trading conditions for the balance of the year.
It earlier announced it had increased its profit by just over 21 percent for the six months to December to NZ$5.6 million.
The decision from both Japan Conference Line and Fesco to concentrate on Lyttelton as their preferred South Island port had brought in additional revenues this year.
Consultants had completed a facility development concept which would enable Lyttelton Port to meet both Coal Corp and Greymouth Coal's growth plans well into the future, it said.
